failures.surface: direct business-policy and inventory-location documentation fingerprints

failures.surface: Product Research Help, Seller Center and Community raw fingerprint requests
failures.attempt: Capture stable HTTP status, ETag, Last-Modified and raw content hash before opening three new public sources.
failures.error: curl HEAD followed repeated eBay error redirects and one request timed out. Headers from error routes could not be treated as canonical source fingerprints.
failures.recovery: Opened the canonical pages in a permitted headed browser, recorded the redirect/timing boundary, and hashed only normalized visible claim sets with the hash scope labeled explicitly.
failures.recurrence_guard: Do not follow an error route into a fake fingerprint, retry aggressively, or claim raw content equality. Use ordinary browser evidence and keep ETag/Last-Modified unknown when the canonical response is unavailable.

failures.recurrence_guard: A search result or old transcript URL is not evidence of current availability. Require the live permitted page or an authorized transcript before distilling content.

failures.surface: local HTTP metadata and SHA256 capture for the dispute/signature increment
failures.attempt: Use Windows PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest plus modern static SHA256 helpers to capture canonical headers and hashes for three eBay Developer pages and the supplemental GitHub source.
failures.error: Invoke-WebRequest raised a NullReference exception, the installed .NET surface lacked SHA256.HashData and Convert.ToHexString, and direct eBay HEAD requests followed error redirects whose headers did not belong to the canonical pages.
failures.recovery: Used ordinary headed-browser evidence for the eBay pages, kept canonical ETag/Last-Modified unknown, hashed normalized visible claim sets with SHA256.Create, and used read-only curl/GitHub API metadata for the public repository. No dependency was installed.
failures.recurrence_guard: Do not treat error-route headers as source fingerprints or assume modern .NET hash helpers exist. Prefer the already-supported read-only curl and SHA256.Create path, label hash scope, and never install a package merely to fingerprint a public page.

failures.surface: read-only deep-browser expressions and Windows command quoting
failures.attempt: Extract GitHub issue anchors, open a filtered PR page containing an ampersand, and pipe an inline PowerShell hash loop during the deep-coverage pass.
failures.error: Two Playwright eval expressions raised ReferenceError, the unquoted ampersand split the PR-list URL into a second shell command, and one inline PowerShell foreach-to-pipeline form produced an empty-pipe parser error.
failures.recovery: Used simpler body-text evaluation, direct PR URLs or query strings without an ampersand, and accumulated hash objects into an array before conversion. All failures were read-only; no page, account or repository state changed.
failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer simple Playwright expressions and direct resource URLs. Never pass an unescaped ampersand through Windows command parsing, and avoid piping directly from an inline foreach block on this PowerShell runtime.

failures.surface: Increment 6 Playwright content hashing and Community metadata extraction on Windows PowerShell
failures.attempt: Hash the Seller Center main element immediately after browser back-navigation, then extract Community JSON-LD dates with a nested regular expression in one CLI command.
failures.error: The Seller Center accessibility main did not map to a populated DOM main element after back-navigation, producing an empty hash, and PowerShell quoting split or rejected two nested JavaScript expressions.

failures.surface: Seller Standards Community recovery advice distillation
failures.attempt: Promote a January 2025 Community Mentor claim that defects always remain for exactly 12 months and a suggestion to sell low-margin or loss-making items to dilute the rate into the general recovery playbook.
failures.error: The current official US policy has a volume-dependent 3-month or 12-month evaluation branch, and the intentional loss-making suggestion has no official support, ignores product margin and could encourage metric gaming. The thread had only two comments, no staff reply and no verified recovery outcome.
failures.recovery: Classified the thread as a fully reviewed `single_case`, retained its wording only as a regression counterexample, and made the current site policy plus bound dashboard/API lookback and exact metric the authoritative diagnosis path.
failures.recurrence_guard: Never convert Mentor role, a fixed age-off statement or volume-dilution advice into platform policy. Cross-check evaluation window, thresholds and consequences on the current site and read the bound seller profile before any recovery recommendation.

failures.surface: anonymous GitHub REST metadata during knowledge-package discovery

failures.error: The anonymous API quota was exhausted before the candidate set was complete.
failures.recovery: Did not read a local token or ask the resting owner for credentials. Used public GitHub HTML, exact raw-content URLs, release/issue/PR/security/discussion pages and read-only git ls-remote watermarks; no clone, install or execution occurred.
failures.recurrence_guard: Treat anonymous API rate limits as a source-access boundary. Rotate to ordinary public HTML/raw/git metadata, label missing fields unknown, and never bypass the limit or expose a token merely to finish a research audit.

failures.error: Every direct and fragment URL returned eBay HTTP 403 before content or scroll coverage was available.
failures.recovery: Closed the isolated sessions, recorded the pages as blocked/opened_not_reviewed, reused the existing fully reviewed Inventory API overview, and read the permitted public text-parser output only as corroboration. No 403 page was promoted to fully_reviewed or hashed as canonical content.
